title.zh: OpenAI、Google等四巨头统一AI训练拒绝规则，网站不用再逐家设置
title.en: OpenAI、Google等四巨头统一AI训练拒绝规则，网站不用再逐家设置

current_state.zh: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic have aligned on a shared robots.txt rule (`User-Agent: __usage_ai-training` + `Disallow: /`) that lets sites opt out of AI training in one step instead of configuring each crawler separately, with Anthropic adopting it now and the others rolling it out between the coming months and 2027 under an IETF draft.
